RSS Feed Add to Google Follow on Google News AI, platforms and compute SoundHound AI (SOUN) unveiled OASYS, a self‑learning orchestrated agentic AI platform billed to let “AI build AI.” Investors will watch adoption and enterprise proof points — successful differentiation could lift ARR and improve revenue stickiness. Cognex (CGNX) introduced its highest‑performance embedded AI vision system with Qualcomm support (details), a direct play on factory automation upgrades and recurring software/component sales. ServiceNow (NOW) expanded governance and automation with an AI Control Tower, new Autonomous Security & Risk integrations and an Autonomous Workforce push — moves that position the company to capture larger shares of enterprise AI spend and simplify vendor consolidation for CIOs. BigBear.ai (BBAI) reported first‑quarter results, increased backlog including more than $60 million in national security contracts and affirmed revenue guidance (release), reinforcing revenue visibility for AI‑enabled analytics vendors in defense spending cycles. Legal sparks and platform competition Cerence AI (CRNC) filed a complaint with the International Trade Commission against Amazon (AMZN), alleging unfair use of its voice and conversational AI tech. This escalates IP and regulatory risk in the automotive and voice‑AI supply chain and could affect partner licensing dynamics. Energy, MLPs and asset sales Plains All American Pipeline (PAA) and Plains GP Holdings provided an update on the NGL sale process. Investors will parse timing and proceeds: asset dispositions can materially shift balance sheets, distributable cash flows and the MLP/GP valuation framework. Occidental (OXY) announced first‑quarter 2026 results (release), which traders will parse for production, cash flow and capital allocation choices amid volatile crude prices. EOG Resources (EOG) reported first‑quarter results (release), another benchmark for North American upstream efficiency and free cash flow trends. Suncor Energy (SU) reported first‑quarter 2026 results (release), a relevant barometer for Canadian oil sands production, margin resilience and dividend considerations as global oil momentum shifts. Battalion Oil (BATL) announced a letter of intent for a joint development agreement to accelerate Monument Draw activity (details), a tactical move that could unlock near‑term production upside if the JV converts acreage into higher‑rate wells. Payments, blockchain rails and treasury strategies Corpay (CPAY) signed JPMorgan and BVNK as blockchain partners to advance tokenized settlement, a development that could compress margins at legacy FX and treasury vendors if adoption accelerates. CEPT (CEPT) — backed by Securitize, Jump Trading Group and Jupiter — launched fully onchain, regulated trading for tokenized equities (announcement), a structural step with long‑term custody and settlement implications. Big tech logistics and commerce moves Amazon (AMZN) widened B2B grocery: businesses in 2,300+ cities can now add fresh groceries to Amazon Business orders (read), helping lift average order size for hospitality and foodservice buyers. Zillow (Z) and Realtor.com set a new standard for pre‑market transparency by extending Preview listings across both platforms (announcement), a workflow change that could alter how listings and lead‑gen value are allocated among proptech players. GXO (GXO) reported first‑quarter results (release), a key read on outsourced logistics demand as retailers optimize inventory turns and last‑mile economics. Airlines & travel Aeromexico (AERO) recognized progress in negotiations with the U.S. Department of Transportation (statement), an update investors will watch for implications on route approvals, codeshares and cross‑border capacity that affect revenue recovery. Capital markets, financings and buybacks Entergy (ETR) announced a public offering of common stock with a forward component (details). Utility equity raises with forward sales affect leverage metrics and investor outlooks on dividend sustainability. Atlan
